exam_scheme.note: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, recruits nursing and technical staff for premier central hospitals in Delhi (Safdarjung, Dr. RML, LHMC, KSCH) through a centralized Computer Based Test (CBT). The examination comprises 60 questions for a total of 240 marks with a duration of 60 minutes. Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct answer and negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect response. The test evaluates domain clinical nursing competencies along with General Awareness, Reasoning, and Basic Quantitative Aptitude. Merit is computed based on CBT performance followed by document verification.

financial_package.note: Nursing Officers in Central Government hospitals under DGHS MoHFW in New Delhi are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900) and are entitled to Class X metro allowances, Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month), and Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/month).
financial_package.pay_source_label: DGHS Advt. No. A.12034/01/2023-PH(H): Level 7 in the Pay Matrix (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + HRA (₹13,470 for New Delhi Class X metro) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo) + Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/mo). Gross in Delhi is ~₹99,100; net in-hand is ~₹84,000–₹86,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and standard taxes.
official_perks: Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month as sanctioned under 7th CPC recommendations
Uniform Allowance of ₹1,800 per month (₹21,600 per annum)
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) comprehensive medical coverage for employee and family
General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA) allotment in New Delhi through Directorate of Estates
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Central Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (₹2,250/child/month)
